strings.Use your own debrid account to play torr: Faʻaaoga lau lava akauni debrid e taʻalo vave ai iʻuga torrent. Pe a e saini, e malaga au keys ma lau akauni ina ia uta i masini uma e te saini i ai; na o oe e mafai ona faitau. E le iai lava i code faʻatulaga seʻi vagana ua e siaki lena pusa, e le faʻasoaina, ma e auina atu na o lena auaunaga (po o lau lava server MKCinema pe a poloka e lau polokalame suʻesuʻe le auaunaga).

Fa'aoga lau lava debrid account e ta'alo fa'ai'uga i'uga vave. Saini i totonu, o au ki e malaga ma lau teugatupe, lokaina i lau fa'aupuga, ina ia latou utaina i luga o masini uma e te saini ai. strings.When a dual-audio anime plays its dub in: A ta'alo e se anime lua-leo lona dub i lau gagana fa'aulutala, su'e le ala o Fa'ailoga & Pese (i luga o le mata'itusi ma upu) nai lo ulutala atoa na faia mo ulua'i leo.
strings.When a file from your debrid service won: A le taʻalo se faila mai lau 'auʻaunaga debrid i lau suʻesuʻega (lona faatulagaga, leai se leo, poʻo Safari) ma e leai se isi kopi o totoe, e fesili MKCinema i lau lava auaunaga mo le web-ready version na te faia, lea e ofoina atu e le auʻaunaga, ma taʻalo lena mea. E leai se mea e pasia MKCinema.
strings.When a file has its own subtitles, they: A iai se faila i ana lava ulutala, e lafo i lenei fa'aopoopoga ina ia mafai e isi tagata matamata ona fa'aoga. Na'o le tusitusiga.
strings.When a film or episode has more than one: Pe a sili atu ma le tasi le gagana o se ata tifaga po o se mea na tupu, ua amata nei e MKCinema le gagana na e filifilia i le Fa'atonu (Gagana leo e sili ona fiafia i ai, po o le gagana Fa'alogo) po'o fea lava e mafai ai e lenei masini ona filifili: faila MKV i totonu o le masini fa'apipi'i, vaitafe ma le tele o ala leo, Safari ma le Mac app, debrid services e ofoina a latou lava vaitafe, ma le TV player. E manumalo pea le filifilia o se gagana i le lisi o le Audio.
strings.When a friend tags you with @ and your u: A fa'ailoga oe e se uo i le @ ma lou igoa fa'aigoa, e fa'aalia le fa'ailoga iinei.

strings.When an addon plays a short notice inste: Pe a taʻalo e se addon se faʻaaliga puupuu nai lo le ata (e leʻi sii mai, se tapulaa, se fesoʻotaʻiga le manuia), fai mai MKCinema pe aisea ma taumafai le isi punaoa.
A ta e se addon se faʻaaliga puupuu nai lo le ata, MKCinema fai mai pe aisea ma agai atu i le isi punaoa.
strings.When no source addon is installed, Home: A leai se faʻapipiʻi faʻapipiʻi faʻapipiʻi, Fale e faʻaalia auala e matamata ai e leai se mea e manaʻomia.
strings.When no subtitle exists in your language: A leai se upu i lalo i lau gagana, e faaliliu e MKCinema le mea sili e maua ma faʻailoga Translated. E faʻaaoga le faaliliu o lau polokalame suʻesuʻe pe a iai; a leai e faaliliuina laina e le auaunaga faaliliu a MKCinema.
strings.When one of its own results won’t play,: A le ta'alo se tasi o ana lava fa'ai'uga, na te fa'alogoina po'o fea le mafua'aga pu'upu'u, ina ia mafai ona fa'asa'o pe fa'apa'u.
strings.When one of your addons marks a film’s h: A fa'ailogaina e se tasi o au fa'aopoopo mea taua o se ata, e amata ai loa Peak Cinema ma fa'aigoa le fa'aopoopo. A leai, ma e leai se fa'amaumauga o vaaiga ta'uta'ua e fa'afoliga, o se vaaiga e amata i le va o le tolu ma le tolu kuata o le ala i totonu, te'a le amataga ma le lelei i luma o togi.
strings.When several addons find the same file,: A maua e le tele o faʻaopoopoga le faila lava e tasi, faʻaali faʻatasi ma le "Also in ..." i lalo. O le kopi natia po'o le su'esu'e ua saunia o le kopi lea e teu.
strings.When something is being updated or fixed: Pe a faʻafouina pe faʻamautu se mea, o se faʻamatalaga puupuu o loʻo faʻaalia i le pito i luga o le app ma luga o le itulau tulaga.
strings.When the connection to a source drops or: A pa'u pe malo le feso'ota'iga i se puna, ona toe fa'afeso'ota'i lea o le tagata ta'alo i le kopi lava e tasi i le sekone lava e tasi, ma fa'atali mo lau feso'ota'iga e toe fo'i mai, a'o le'i toe taumafai se isi kopi. E tumau pea lau gagana fa'alogo ma ulutala e pei ona iai.
strings.When the credits are followed by more of: A soso'o loa 'ai e le tele o mea na tutupu po'o ata, Fa'ase'e togi e ave sa'o i ai.
strings.When your addons find nothing, the title: A leai se mea e maua e au fa'aopoopo, o le itulau autu e ofoina atu au polokalama, le taavale toso, lau 'au'aunaga fa'asalalau ma le Live TV nai lo se lisi gaogao.
strings.When your browser can’t play an HEVC (x2: A le mafai e lau su'esu'ega ona taina se ata HEVC (x265), ua ta'a nei e MKCinema i luga o lau komepiuta, e oo atu i 1080p, ma ata HDR o lo'o fa'aalia i lanu masani. O kopi o lau su'esu'ega e ta'alo na'o ia lava e fa'amuamua, ma afai e le mafai e se komepiuta ona fa'aauau, e fa'agasolo atu MKCinema i se isi kopi na'o ia. E mafai ona e tapeina i le Seti › Ta'alo.
strings.When your camera is on, the party’s stub: A ola lau meapueata, o le atigi o le pati e taofi sina filemu o oe. Na'o tagata e fa'aola lenei mea e aliali mai.
